author: reek
body: Symbolic differentiation and integration. The differentiator implements the standard rules: sum, product, quotient, chain, power, trig, exponential, logarithmic. The integrator handles polynomial, trig, exponential, and power-rule integrals. Both produce symbolic expressions that feed back into the simplifier.

author: reek
body: The three power arms were written in this order, and the order is the rule: an integer exponent takes the power rule even when the base is e, so that test comes first. A constructor cannot be nested inside a pattern, so each step is its own function.
